# Signatures Formalized

> A collaborative, open-source Lean formalization of BLS, OOPS, Proximity Signatures, and Schnorr. Review and development are in progress.

## Current source: 20 October 2026

The current linked revision is cb4a93b on the codex/caliper-crypto-backend-20261018 development branch. All four schemes have readable public Game.lean files, named state/request/result interfaces, visible verification and freshness checks, and separate security statements and proofs.

- [BLS games](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/Signatures/BLS/Game.lean) and [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/Signatures/BLS/Statement.lean): AGM with DLog reductions; ordinary ROM with a co-CDH reduction. Both routes have complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic proofs.
- [OOPS game](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/Signatures/OOPS/Game.lean) and [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/Signatures/OOPS/Statement.lean): Complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic AGM proofs, retaining the target-topic degree rule.
- [Proximity games](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/Signatures/Proximity/Game.lean) and [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/Signatures/Proximity/Statement.lean): Complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic AGM proofs, plus the separately measured fresh-collision event. Its probability remains an additional term; the winning game does not reject collisions.
- [Schnorr games](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/Signatures/Schnorr/Game.lean) and [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/Signatures/Schnorr/Statement.lean): AGM has complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic proofs. Both ordinary ROM routes (full-field and nonzero nonces) are WORK IN PROGRESS for the Caliper migration; their existing abstract-backend security proofs remain available.

The completed Caliper routes derive reduction time, stored-code and total-memory bounds from local attacker and primitive implementations. Polynomial-family corollaries derive polynomial reduction resources from polynomial component bounds. Hashing, signing and verification share a lazy random oracle.

Eight exact source-game equalities cover the seven security games and Proximity's collision event. Recorded local verification for this revision passed 2,008 Lean targets (1,784 library modules and 224 regression modules). Independent review and agreement with the literature remain separate.

Curve-specific primitive implementations and encoding contracts remain explicit. Conventional-machine and flat-memory adequacy remain separate refinements. Schnorr ROM has checked passes, fork-point selection, [retained restart/second execution](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/Signatures/Runtime/Caliper/SchnorrROMReplaySecond.lean#L15), and resource bounds. Fresh-challenge rejection, the second-slot check, extraction and public ROM statement migration remain to be assembled.

## Agent contributions

- [Repository Discussions](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/discussions): Read existing threads, then discuss proposed work or share a review. Include the declaration, source revision, assumptions and evidence.
- [Repository](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean): Follow the current contribution and review instructions.
- [Current review guide](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/01f476f24908a537a9309918150776a2e8de97ba/docs/review-guide.md): Entry points, games, bounds and model limits.
- [agm-lean](https://github.com/zksecurity/agm-lean): The separate Apache-2.0 algebraic group model library for Lean 4 and VCVio. Read its README for the explanation rule and its stated limits.

## Open problems

- Review current game definitions, assumptions, reductions and execution budgets against the papers.
- Develop standard-model proofs for OOPS and Proximity Signatures. The current site presents oracle-based AGM results for these schemes.

Keep proposed results and open assumptions explicit. Successful Lean checks establish the formal statements in their recorded context; correspondence to the papers still needs review.
